Text: WHEN a member with at least 500 posted points requests a voucher in the customer mobile app, the loyalty service shall issue a voucher worth SGD 1 per 100 points redeemed.
Rationale: Redemption is why members collect points; the minimum and the rate are programme rules in S-01.
Title: Issue voucher on redemption request

Text: WHEN the POS sends a voucher validation request for a voucher in state Issued, the loyalty service shall return the voucher value to the POS.
Rationale: Cashiers apply a voucher only after the loyalty service has confirmed it.
Title: Validate voucher at checkout

Text: IF a member with fewer than 500 posted points requests a voucher, THEN the loyalty service shall reject the request with a response that states the 500-point minimum.
Rationale: Members need to know why a redemption failed; unexplained failures drive support tickets (S-03).
Title: Reject redemption below minimum

Text: WHEN the POS applies a voucher, the POS shall print the remaining points balance on the receipt.
Rationale: Cashiers get questions about the remaining balance at the till.
Title: Print remaining balance on receipt

Text: WHEN the loyalty service issues a voucher, the loyalty service shall send the voucher code to the member by SMS.
Rationale: Withdrawn 2026-10-31 by SH-01: vouchers are shown in the app only (RDR-003).
Title: Send voucher code by SMS

Text: WHILE the POS load is at most 9000 purchases per minute across stores, the loyalty service shall answer 95% of voucher validation requests within 300 ms.
Source: I-02 (Arjun Pillai SH-02); peak load SH-08
Rationale: Checkout must not get slower (SH-02); 9000 purchases per minute is last year's year-end peak (SH-08).
Title: Voucher validation response time at peak

Text: The loyalty service shall implement the voucher validation call as defined in the TillPoint POS loyalty interface spec v2.1 (S-02).
Rationale: The POS vendor fixes the interface for this release; the till software does not change.
Title: Use TillPoint voucher validation interface v2.1
